in_sanskrit.name: मनराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: मनस् (manas) - mind, राज (raja) - ruler. Thus, Manraj means the one who rules the mind.

in_hindi.name: मनराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: मन (man) - moon, राज (raja) - ruler. Thus, Manraj means the one who rules over the moon.

in_tamil.name: மன்றாஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: மன் (man) - mind, ராஜ் (raja) - ruler. Thus, Manraj means the one who rules over the mind.

in_telugu.name: మన్రాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: మనస్ (manas) - mind, రాజ్ (raja) - ruler. Thus, Manraj means the one who rules over the mind.

in_marathi.name: Manraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manraj is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘raj’ meaning ruler or king. This name signifies a person who rules their mind and thoughts, and is often associated with wisdom and intelligence.
